plan.title: Pipeline rows: widen issue title to reclaim wasted horizontal space (keep compact height)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: Pipeline rows on the Command Deck / Project Overview truncate the issue title far too early (e.g. 'Review pipeline strande…') while leaving empty horizontal space. PipelineRow uses a fixed 5-column grid ('88px 1fr 200px 90px 34px', PipelineRow.tsx:44); at the typical container width (~580px) the fixed 200px status column starves the 1fr title column down to ~120px, causing the early ellipsis with whitespace to its right.
narratives.Proposal: Adopt Proposal B: collapse the 5-column grid into a title-first 4-column grid '78px 1fr 74px 34px'. Line 1 is the full-width title (truncate). Line 2 is a single inline metadata row: the status chip (colored dot + label, shrink-0) followed by sublineFor(entry) and whoLineFor(entry) joined by ' · ', truncating as one unit. Cost ($X.XX) + 'N sessions' keep their own right-aligned column. The colored status dot and the avatar ring are unchanged. Row height stays exactly two text lines. Single file: PipelineRow.tsx. Helpers pipelineChipFor / sublineFor / whoLineFor / sessionCountFor / formatPipelineCost are reused as-is (no signature changes).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to pipeline-helpers.ts logic (chip/subline/whoLine/cost/session-count content is untouched).
- No changes to grouping, sorting, or section headers ('Being reviewed', 'Being built', etc.).
- No new vertical height per row (must remain exactly two text lines).
- No new tests are authored; the existing ProjectOverview.test.tsx must stay green.
- No user-facing docs change (no Mintlify/docs page describes this row's column layout).

autoDecisions.summary: Implement exactly Proposal B from the issue body (4-column grid, merged title+metadata stack), not an alternative layout.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body names Proposal B as the operator-selected design and supplies the full before/after code; --auto planning must choose the documented recommended option rather than invent a variant.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship as a single bead rather than decomposing.
autoDecisions.rationale: The change is one atomic JSX rewrite in one file; a partially-migrated grid (4-col template with 5-col children, or vice versa) leaves a visually broken row, so the work is genuinely indivisible and cannot be split into independently-mergeable slices.

autoDecisions.summary: Author no new test; rely on the existing ProjectOverview.test.tsx staying green.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue reuses helpers with no signature changes and its acceptance criteria only require the existing test to keep passing; adding speculative snapshot tests is out of the requested scope (simplicity-first).

items.title: Collapse PipelineRow to a title-first 4-column grid (Proposal B)

expected_outputs: ProjectOverview.test.tsx passes with all assertions green

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/PipelineRow.tsx, change the grid template on the row container (currently PipelineRow.tsx:44, style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '88px 1fr 200px 90px 34px' }}) to '78px 1fr 74px 34px'. Remove the standalone 200px status column (current lines 53-65: the flex-col wrapping the chip and whoLine). Restructure the title column (current lines 48-51) into a two-line stack: line 1 keeps the full-width truncating title (block truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground); line 2 becomes a single inline metadata row — a flex container with 'mt-[3px] flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 overflow-hidden text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground' holding (a) the status chip as an inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-full badge (px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px], chip.bgClass, chip.textClass) containing the existing colored dot span (h-[7px] w-[7px] shrink-0 rounded-full, chip.dotClass, chip.animate && 'animate-pulse') and chip.label, and (b) an inner truncate span rendering [sublineFor(entry), whoLineFor(entry)].filter(Boolean).join(' · '). Keep the cost column (block truncate cost + '{sessionCountFor(feature)} sessions') exactly as-is but it is now the 3rd grid column, and keep the avatar span (current lines 72-79) unchanged as the 4th column. Truncation contract: chip is shrink-0, the flex container carries min-w-0 overflow-hidden, and only the inner text span carries truncate — do NOT put truncate on the flex container itself. The .filter(Boolean) is required because whoLineFor returns string | null (pipeline-helpers.ts:242) and a null must not produce a dangling ' · '.

items.title: Given the pipeline row, the container renders gridTemplateColumns '78px 1fr 74px 34px' and no 200px status column remains in the markup.

Given a long title (e.g. 'Review pipeline stranded in review-blocked state after specialist convoy timeout'), the title span occupies the full width between the issueId and cost columns and only ellipsizes when the text genuinely exceeds that width — rendering far more characters than the prior ~120px column.

Given an entry, the status chip (colored dot + label), sublineFor text, and whoLineFor line render on ONE metadata line beneath the title, joined by ' · ', and the sublineFor/whoLineFor tail truncates as a single unit.

Given whoLineFor(entry) returns null, the metadata line renders no trailing ' · ' separator; and the cost ($X.XX) plus 'N sessions' remain in a right-aligned column with row height preserved at exactly two text lines.
npm run typecheck and npm run lint complete without new errors and ProjectOverview.test.tsx passes green (its title, stuck-reason subline, cost, and session-count assertions all still satisfied).
